record.question: Humpty Dumpty sat _____________ a wall. Fill in the blank with the correct preposition.
record.explanation: Answer A: on. “Humpty Dumpty sat on a wall” is the familiar nursery-rhyme expression; on is the correct preposition. Independent check: “Sit on a wall” is the conventional preposition in the quoted nursery-rhyme line. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/verbs-followed-by-prepositions-and-prepositions-followed-by-ing-forms; https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/clauses. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Exact printed question, choices and required directions/emphasis reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
